unresolved_concerns.title: Baseline clean same-concept training composition and necessity claim
unresolved_concerns.location: Introduction p2 and Section4.2 p7; Xu2024 Sections4.1-4.2 pp6-7
unresolved_concerns.source_claim: Prior example poisoned all Biden instances in learner training and assumed no benign Biden examples.
unresolved_concerns.correction_to_predecessor: Small-M injection from a larger poison candidate pool does not show unpoisoned Biden examples were retained in the final learner training set. The alleged counterexample does not meet that operative condition.
unresolved_concerns.verified_facts: The baseline constructs200-300 candidates, samplesM, appends only chosen poison entries to preexisting clean-data annotations and reports high success at budgets around50. Unused candidate images are not thereby inserted as benign training examples.
unresolved_concerns.alternative_reading: Perturbing all277 can describe pool generation; all-in-training can describe final concept composition. Both are compatible with subset injection if the preexisting clean set has no Biden examples.
unresolved_concerns.needed: Actual baseline clean-data concept composition or a matched successful attack retaining benign destination-concept training examples. The inspected budget sweep neither proves necessity nor refutes it under the relevant condition.
unresolved_concerns.counterevidence: MP-Nav explicitly tests added clean Biden instances; that comparison remains distinct.
